facts.description: Thread view module: builds read-model views for thread lists, thread detail, search, and decisions

import_class.description: Imports thread key helper and Thread, Ticket, Trigger core types
Imports the ThreadFilter type from the API module
Imports the TextCache type from the cache module
Imports view helpers (snapshot, paging, summaries, trigger/decision views) and ViewHost type from records
Imports the attribute helper from the text view module

function.function_id: src/app/views/threads.ts:threadList(host: ViewHost, filter: ThreadFilter, offset: number, limit: number)
function.description: Builds a paged, filtered thread list (recent/all/subscribed/evaluating) with summaries, sorted by last activity

function.function_id: src/app/views/threads.ts:threadDetail(host: ViewHost, key: string, before: string | undefined, limit: number, around?: string)
function.description: Builds a thread detail view with timeline triggers, tickets, related threads and decisions using timestamp|id cursors

function.function_id: src/app/views/threads.ts:search(host: ViewHost, query: string, links: Pick<TextCache, 'entries'>)
function.description: Searches tickets, triggers and threads by query or source link and returns top 20 ranked results

function.function_id: src/app/views/threads.ts:decisionList(host: ViewHost, kinds: string[], offset: number, limit: number, since = '')
function.description: Returns a paged list of decisions filtered by kinds and since, with next offset
